runs.text: Read 9 numbers, row by row, of a 3 × 3 grid. It is magic if all the rows, all the columns and both diagonals add up to the same. Show

hints.text: How many sums do you have to compare? Which number do you compare them with?
It is the noughts and crosses of
with sums instead of equal cells.
Take the sum of the first row as the target; a single different sum is enough for it not to be magic.
A boolean box starts as true and changes if any row, column or diagonal does not add up to the target. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Also require the nine numbers to be different.
The last hidden case has rows and diagonals that add up to 15 but two columns that do not: it uncovers whoever does not check the columns.
